zh.sourceText: 市教育局宣布，下学期起在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教，由系统为每个学生生成个性化练习。研发方称，早期测试中 AI 助教让班级平均分提升了 12 分，且能解放教师重复批改的时间。一位受访教师补充，学生更愿意向不会嘲笑自己的程序提问，课堂参与更主动。不过教育学者提醒，个性化练习依赖学生答题数据，存在隐私外泄的风险；也有家长质疑，机器能否替代师生间的情感陪伴。某培训机构借势推广：用了 AI 助教，孩子半年上清北！

textRefs.conclusion_1: 下学期起在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教
textRefs.reason_1: 早期测试中 AI 助教让班级平均分提升了 12 分
textRefs.reason_2: 学生更愿意向不会嘲笑自己的程序提问，课堂参与更主动
textRefs.reason_3: 能解放教师重复批改的时间
textRefs.distractor_1: 个性化练习依赖学生答题数据
textRefs.distractor_2: 用了 AI 助教，孩子半年上清北

hints: 结论是第一句话里的『决定』：市教育局要做什么？
真正的理由来自研发方和教师——注意它们分别用数据、心理、效率支撑
陷阱：『依赖答题数据』听起来像在说效率，其实是在提醒风险；培训广告更不是理由
zh.explanation: 结论是「在 30 所中学试点 AI 助教」。三条理由分别是：①数据——平均分提升 12 分；②心理——学生敢向不嘲笑人的程序提问；③效率——解放教师重复批改。注意「个性化练习依赖学生答题数据」看似在讲功能，实际是学者提出的隐私风险，并不是支持试点的理由；「半年上清北」是培训机构的夸张广告。进阶难度在于：有些句子读起来像理由，实则是反对意见或营销话术，必须逐句判断它是否真的在支撑结论。

en.sourceText: The education bureau announced that starting next semester, AI teaching assistants will be piloted in 30 middle schools, with the system generating personalized practice for each student. The developer says that in early tests AI assistants raised the class average by 12 points and freed teachers from repetitive grading. An interviewed teacher added that students are more willing to ask a program that will not laugh at them, making class participation more active. Education scholars, however, warn that personalized practice relies on student answer data and risks privacy leaks; some parents also question whether machines can replace the emotional bond between teachers and students. A training agency is cashing in: use AI assistants and your child gets into a top university in half a year!

textRefs.conclusion_1: starting next semester, AI teaching assistants will be piloted in 30 middle schools
textRefs.reason_1: in early tests AI assistants raised the class average by 12 points
textRefs.reason_2: students are more willing to ask a program that will not laugh at them, making class participation more active
textRefs.distractor_1: personalized practice relies on student answer data
textRefs.distractor_2: use AI assistants and your child gets into a top university in half a year

hints: The conclusion is the decision in the first sentence: what will the bureau do?
Real reasons come from the developer and the teacher — data, psychology, efficiency
Trap: 'relies on answer data' sounds like a feature but is a privacy risk; the ad is not a reason
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'pilot AI teaching assistants in 30 middle schools'. Three reasons: ① data — average up 12 points; ② psychology — students dare ask a program that won't laugh; ③ efficiency — frees teachers from repetitive grading. Note that 'personalized practice relies on student answer data' sounds functional but is actually the scholar's privacy risk, not a reason for the pilot; 'top university in half a year' is an agency's exaggeration. The intermediate challenge: some sentences read like reasons but are objections or slogans — judge each one by whether it truly supports the conclusion.
